The qualifying test consists of multiple-choice questions and assesses knowledge in grammar, vocabulary (especially in the business area), and text comprehension.
The required level to pass this test is B2.2.
The qualifying test is offered every semester before the start of lectures.
Mandatory for all students who have not successfully completed an elective module course in the respective language.
Mandatory participation can only be waived with specific language certificates.

Cambridge English C1 certificate, TOEFL test of at least 100 points, IELTS test from 7.5 points, C1 language certificate from completing a Bachelor's elective module in Business English from previous semesters.
Baccalauréat, Abibac, DALF / DELF C1, C1 language certificate from completing a Bachelor's elective module in Business French from previous semesters.
C1 language certificate from completing a Bachelor's elective module in Business Spanish from previous semesters.
You can upload your existing language certificate only within the specified time windows. Certificates submitted outside this platform will not be accepted.
You must register with your student ID number to start the test.
Your language certificates will be sent by email approximately 6 weeks after the end of the course.
